notes.title: Devlog 1 - What is Pit Fighter Tycoon?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42554905/4b32ddbb7477e1ebcc413343e9b4fca0f8187a18.png[/img]

In our first video devlog we overview the game and discuss abducting, upgrading and sending humans to fight and die for your sense of pride [i](and accomplishment)[/i]. 

We cover the high level features in the game including base building, organ trading, skill trees, equipment management, quests and character dialogue! 

[previewyoutube=J7qgmIsN9LU;full][/previewyoutube]
